OK friend, I have been necromancy ritualling
See my ritual inventory - I need to do Powerful necroplasm rituals, give me a guide on how best to do this for maximal returns on my powerful necroplasm

Awesome work pushing your Necromancy to **Level 106**! You are in prime position to maximize your returns, as your level unlocks Tier 3 ritual glyphs like **Multiply III**, which dramatically boosts product output per ritual. To get the absolute highest yield of **Powerful Necroplasm** from your **Greater Necroplasm**, here is your ultimate setup and strategy guide for running [Powerful Necroplasm II](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm_II). --- ### 1. Key Ritual Selection: Powerful Necroplasm II Do **NOT** run Powerful Necroplasm I. At level 106, you have full access to [Powerful Necroplasm II](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_necroplasm_II), which gives the best base conversion rate and allows maximum glyph slot customization on the Tier 3 platform. * **Base Input:** 20 Greater Necroplasm + 8 Powerful Communal Ink * **Base Output:** 20 Powerful Necroplasm --- ### 2. The Maximal Yield Setup (Glyphs & Light Sources) To maximize yield, fill every optional glyph slot with **Multiply III** glyphs. Each Multiply III glyph adds **+20% base item output**. | Slot Type | Glyph / Light Source | Required Inks | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Required Glyphs (4)** | 2× [Change III](https://runescape.wiki/w/Change_III)
1× [Reagent III](https://runescape.wiki/w/Reagent_III)
1× [Elemental III](https://runescape.wiki/w/Elemental_III) | Powerful / Greater Inks | Required to activate Powerful Necroplasm II | | **Optional Glyphs (7)** | 7× [Multiply III](https://runescape.wiki/w/Multiply_III) | Powerful / Greater Inks | **+140% Base Yield** total extra output | | **Light Sources (8)** | 8× [Powerful Candle](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_candle) | N/A | Maximum durability & ritual speed | > **Yield Math:** With 7 Multiply III glyphs (+140% yield), a single ritual turns **20 Greater Necroplasm into 48 Powerful Necroplasm** before additional boosts! --- ### 3. Equipment & Passive Output Boosters Stack these extra boosts to squeeze even more output out of every single batch: * **[Necromancy Skillcape](https://runescape.wiki/w/Necromancy_cape)** *(Requires Level 99 - You are 106!)*: * **Effect:** Gives a **10% chance to double** the output produced during rituals. Wear it or place it on your Anachronia Skillcape Stand. * **[Tome of Um](https://runescape.wiki/w/Tome_of_Um)** (2 / 3 / 4): * **Effect:** Equipping the Tome of Um gives a passive percentage bonus to extra necroplasm produced (Tome 2 = +2%, Tome 3 = +5%, Tome 4 = +10%). Complete Area Tasks in the City of Um if you haven't upgraded yours yet! * **[First Necromancer's Outfit](https://runescape.wiki/w/First_Necromancer%27s_robes)** (if owned): * Wearing pieces of this set grants additional ritual XP and bonuses. --- ### 4. Step-by-Step Action Plan 1. **Craft/Stock Ghostly Inks:** * Ensure you have plenty of [Powerful Ritual Ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Powerful_ritual_ink) and [Greater Ritual Ink](https://runescape.wiki/w/Greater_ritual_ink) ready to draw and repair your T3 glyphs. 2. **Draw the Platform:** * Lay down your **4 mandatory ritual glyphs** (2 Change III, 1 Reagent III, 1 Elemental III). * Fill the remaining **7 open slots** exclusively with **Multiply III**. 3. **Place Focus & Material:** * Load the pedestal with **20 Greater Necroplasm** and **8 Powerful Communal Ink**. 4. **Disturbances (Optional for XP/Materials):** * If your main goal is pure AFK conversion speed, you can focus strictly on restarting the ritual. If you want maximum XP towards **120 Necromancy**, click all disturbance events ([Defile](https://runescape.wiki/w/Defile), [Corrupt Wandering Soul](https://runescape.wiki/w/Corrupt_Wandering_Soul), etc.) as they appear. Following this setup will allow you to quickly convert your hoard of Greater Necroplasm into massive stacks of Powerful Necroplasm to fuel your combat incantations, high-tier armor upgrades, and push toward **120 Necromancy**!
